One-time setup for the Scan now button
  1. Open GitHub → new fine-grained token.
  2. Name it "scan button", set an expiry (up to 1 year).
  3. Repository access: Only select repositories → breakout-scanner.
  4. Permissions → Repository → Actions: Read and write. Nothing else.
  5. Generate, copy the token, paste it here and tap Save.

The token stays in this browser only. It can do nothing except start and read runs of this one repository. Without it, the buttons open GitHub's Run page instead.

Market review

  • Indexes. The S&P 500 rose 1.3% and is -2.3% over the past month, below its 50-day average (mixed). Small caps led over the month (Nasdaq-100 -7.2%, Russell 2000 +2.3%).
  • Breadth. Participation is narrow: 44% of US stocks are above their 50-day average and 41% above their 200-day. 114 new 52-week highs vs 173 new lows; 59% of stocks advanced, carrying 76% of the dollar volume. Over 10 days, new highs minus new lows average -131 a day and 48% of dollar volume went into rising stocks. 7 distribution days in the last 25 sessions point to institutional selling.
  • Risk. Volatility is normal: VIX 17.5 (-2.0). The US 10-year yield is 5.00% (+10 bp this week). USD/CAD 1.4264. Credit markets are calm (high-yield bonds holding up against Treasuries).
  • Metals. Gold/silver ratio 77 (rising over the month); gold is leading silver. Real yields are falling (TIPS +0.7% over the month), a tailwind for precious metals. Seasonally, September-February is metals' strongest stretch.
  • Sectors. Leading over the month: Health Care (+11.4%) and Consumer Staples (+8.6%). Lagging: Technology (-11.2%) and Energy (-5.7%).
  • Canada. The TSX 60 is +0.9% on the day and +2.0% over the month (uptrend); 56% of TSX stocks are above their 50-day average, with Utilities leading.

Assurant, Inc. provides protection services to connected devices, homes, and automobiles in North America, Latin America, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through Global Lifestyle and Global Housing segments.

More about the company

Assurant, Inc. provides protection services to connected devices, homes, and automobiles in North America, Latin America, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through Global Lifestyle and Global Housing segments. The Global Lifestyle segment offers mobile device solutions, and extended service contracts and related services for consumer electronics and appliances, and credit and other insurance products; and vehicle protection, commercial equipment protection, and other related services. Kinaxis Inc. Software - Application · Technology · Canada

Kinaxis Inc. provides cloud-based subscription software-as-a-service for supply chain operations in the United States, Europe, Asia, and Canada.

More about the company

Kinaxis Inc. provides cloud-based subscription software-as-a-service for supply chain operations in the United States, Europe, Asia, and Canada. The company offers Kinaxis Maestro, an AI-infused supply chain orchestration platform for artificial intelligence, concurrency, developer studio, integration, security, and user experience. In addition, the company offers professional services for implementation and configuration of the product; ongoing technical services; training, enablement, and continuous learning services; and maintenance and support services. It serves the aerospace and defense, automotive, chemical, consumer products, high-tech and electronics, industrial, life sciences, and logistics industries. SiriusPoint Ltd. Insurance - Reinsurance · Financial Services · Bermuda

SiriusPoint Ltd. provides multi-line reinsurance and insurance products and services worldwide. It operates through four segments: Global P&C Programs, Global Reinsurance, Global Accident & Health, and London Market Specialty.

More about the company

SiriusPoint Ltd. provides multi-line reinsurance and insurance products and services worldwide. It operates through four segments: Global P&C Programs, Global Reinsurance, Global Accident & Health, and London Market Specialty. The Global P&C Programs segment offers programs space to clients and distribution partners. The Global Reinsurance segment provides casualty, property, and other specialties, such as proportional and excess of loss, treaty and facultative, aviation and space, marine and energy, and credit to insurance and reinsurance companies, government entities, and other risk bearing vehicles. The Global Accident & Health segment provides accident and health, property and casualty, aviation and space, credit, surety, marine and energy, and mortgage. The London Market Specialty segment provides London casualty, energy, property, and marine leaders services. The company offers medical insurance products, trip cancellation programs, medical management services, and 24/7 emergency medical and travel assistance services. The company was formerly known as Third Point Reinsurance Ltd. and changed its name to SiriusPoint Ltd. in February 2021. SiriusPoint Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Pembroke, Bermuda. Company website

Pediatrix Medical Group, Inc. Medical Care Facilities · Healthcare · United States

Pediatrix Medical Group, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides newborn, maternal-fetal, and other pediatric subspecialty care services in the United States.

More about the company

Pediatrix Medical Group, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides newborn, maternal-fetal, and other pediatric subspecialty care services in the United States. The company offers clinical care to babies born prematurely or with complications within specific units at hospitals, primarily NICUs, through its network of affiliated neonatal physician subspecialists, neonatal nurse practitioners, and other pediatric clinicians; and inpatient and office-based clinical care to expectant mothers and unborn babies through its affiliated maternal-fetal medicine subspecialists, obstetricians and other clinicians, maternal-fetal medicine nurse practitioners, certified nurse midwives, sonographers, and genetic counselors. It also provides other pediatric subspecialty care, including pediatric intensivists, pediatric hospitalists, and pediatric surgeons; support services in other areas of hospitals comprising pediatric emergency room, labor and delivery area, and nursery and pediatric departments; a newborn hearing screening program. What the labels mean

  • Buy Breakout confirmed and it passes the scorecard (70+/100, reward:risk 2+, no earnings within 5 sessions, under 4 warnings). Entry plan below.
  • Watch Breakout not confirmed yet, or it held but doesn't pass the scorecard. Not a buy yet.
  • Don't chase Breakout held but price ran too far above the breakout level. Wait for a pullback.
  • Hold You own it (if you took the Buy). Keep the stop order in place.
  • Take profit Target hit. Sell part, protect the rest.
  • Hold - trailing Holding the remainder with a stop that rises with the price.
  • Sell Exit the position (or your stop order already did).
  • Drop Setup failed or never qualified before entry. Remove from watchlist.

Entry, stop and target are calculated from the breakout level. Profit/loss is measured from the close on the day of the Buy signal; your real entry is the next open. A Buy is exited early if it closes back below the breakout level within 10 sessions (failed breakout).

The score is a pass mark, not a ranking: in the 2022-26 backtest, setups scoring 70-74 did as well as or better than those scoring 75+. Position size risks 1% of the account per trade, so a run of 20 losses (Douglas's sample size) would cost about 18%.
